levels.spec: 100 locked spec + schema + a Stack B contract artifact; 75 locked spec + schema; 50 locked spec or owner-approved block document only; 25 direction only; 0 none
levels.impl: fraction of the cluster's requirement units that work in Stack B (a unit that exists only as a table or repository counts 0.25; a vertical slice for one action counts 0.5-0.75); multiplied into functional, integration, verification and operational
levels.integration: 100 end to end through the real API and database AND the user-facing path; 75 cross-layer end to end through API and database, no UI; 50 reachable through an API route with integration tests; 25 repository or service level only; 0 none
levels.verification: 100 unit + integration + architecture guards + mutation or negative proofs; 75 integration + architecture guards; 50 integration or unit only; 25 structural only; 0 none
levels.operational: 100 deployed and observed in production (nothing qualifies); 50 runbook + health or monitoring endpoint + kill switch + CI gate; 25 runbook or health endpoint only; 0 none. An undeployed feature is never production accepted.
